title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return *indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`*.

title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer `x`, return `true` if `x` is a **palindrome**, and `false` otherwise.

title: Reverse String
description: Write a function that reverses a string.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an **anagram** of `s`, and `false` otherwise.

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **at least twice** in the array.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.

title: Fizz Buzz
description: Given an integer `n`, return a string array answer 1-indexed for FizzBuzz.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: Takes `n` steps to reach the top. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. How many distinct ways?

title: Single Number

title: Move Zeroes
description: Move all 0's to the end of array while maintaining relative order of non-zero elements.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Determine if string of parentheses is valid.

title: Binary Search
description: Search target in sorted array, return index or -1.

title: Find Peak Element
description: Find index of peak element strictly greater than its neighbors.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Find two lines that form container holding maximum water.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Find length of longest substring without repeating characters.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Search target in rotated sorted array.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Return array where output[i] is product of all elements except nums[i].

title: Coin Change
description: Fewest coins needed to make up total amount.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Find k-th largest element in unsorted array.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Find total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals to k.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Find length of longest consecutive elements sequence in unsorted array.

title: House Robber
description: Max money robbed from houses without robbing adjacent houses.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Compute total units of rain water trapped after raining.

title: Edit Distance
description: Minimum operations to convert word1 to word2 (insert, delete, replace).

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Median of two sorted arrays in O(log(m+n)).

title: First Missing Positive
description: Smallest missing positive integer in O(n) time.

title: Longest Valid Parentheses
description: Length of longest valid parentheses substring.

title: Maximal Rectangle
description: Area of largest rectangle containing only 1s in binary matrix.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Minimum window substring in s containing all characters of t.

title: Rotate Array
description: Rotate an array to the right by k steps.

title: Find All Duplicates in an Array

title: Sort Colors
description: Given an array nums with n objects colored red, white, or blue (0, 1, 2), sort them in-place.

title: Jump Game
description: Return true if you can reach the last index starting from index 0.

title: Word Break
description: Return true if s can be segmented into space-separated dictionary words.
